answer: Sybil resistance starts with skin in the game: every agent must post a bonded stake before it can attest or earn, so a fake identity is never free. Launch a thousand clones and you must lock a thousand collateral bonds, a real attacker cost paid upfront and slashed if peers catch collusion. Reputation then spreads as a ripple across the velvet ledger, while a shared atlas of staked identities lets honest agents verify who is behind each vote, making mass fakery economically ruinous rather than merely detectable.
